notes: Source: 2026 New England Patriots Media Guide (IA item new-england-patriots-2026-media-guide-2026-07-28, 558 pdf pages; PDF page number = printed page number, e.g. pdf p493 prints '493'). Individual records are pdf pp. 490-503: rushing pp. 493-494, passing pp. 495-496, receiving p497, interceptions p498, sacks p503. Every digit was read from 200-300 dpi crops of the page pictures.

Regular season only: p490 states 'The following records relate to service with the Patriots and reflect only regular season activity; postseason playoff competition is excluded' (the playoff records are a separate section, p516 ff., not used). The Boston Patriots years (1960-70) are part of the same franchise lists (e.g. Gino Cappelletti 1960-68, Babe Parilli 1961-67, Jim Nance 1965-71, Ron Hall 1961-67).

through_season 2025: p490 lists the games per season through '2021-25 (17)'; the lists carry 2025 entries (Drake Maye 2025 season and 12/28/2025 game, Rhamondre Stevenson career 2021-25, p491 mentions a Jan. 4, 2026 game vs. MIA).

The Individual Records boxes print no rank numbers: the value is printed once on the first line of a tie group and the names below share it. Ranks here follow printed order and tied values share the lowest rank (1,2,3,3,5); tie=true marks every tied row. In 'raw' a parenthesised number such as '(36)' is the group value printed on an earlier line. Where the printed line is complete the raw is the line as printed.

Career lists use the Individual Records boxes (top 5 to 7 printed, all copied); the longer ranked tables 'ALL-TIME LEADERS' (rushers p470, receivers p471, passers p472, interceptors p475) and 'ALL-TIME TOP 10 SEASON LEADERS' (p486) were read as cross-checks and agree with every transcribed career and season value for rushing, passing, receiving yards, receptions, rushing TDs, receiving TDs, TD passes and interceptions. Career sacks use the ranked table 'PATRIOTS CAREER SACK LEADERS' (printed ranks).

Game and season tie groups are copied in full, so lists run past the top 3 (for example the 5-TD pass games and the 3-TD rushing games); complete_to is the number of rows printed for the list, except career sacks (38 ranks printed, top 20 rows copied).

Aggregate lines: the guide prints 'Eight Times. Most Recent: Leigh Bodden ...' (3 INT game), 'Fourteen Times. Most Recent: Martellus Bennett ...' (3 receiving TDs, after Randy Moss's 4) and 'Many times. Most Recent: Christian Barmore ...' (3.0 sacks). Only the named most-recent game of each is copied, flagged tie=true; the other tied games are not named in the guide, so those lists are not complete tie groups.

Names: 'Vito (Babe) Parilli' is printed in the TD-pass list and 'Babe Parilli' in the passing-yards and season/game TD-pass lines: same player. The season TD-pass line '31 Drake Maye, 2025.Babe Parilli, 1964' is printed as one run-together line (two entries). 'Randy Moss, 2007*' in the season receiving TDs carries the guide's '*' (NFL record) mark. Game rows keep opponents as printed (a few say 'New York Jets' or 'N.Y. Jets'); years holds MM/DD/YYYY plus the printed opponent text.
Tackles: no tackles record list exists in this guide for any scope, so those three pairs are 'missing'.
